cond_0220.intro: This position is responsible for providing leadership to technical teams developing and maintaining cost effective processes and procedures for assigned parts used in the manufacture of parts and assemblies. Also, providing technical support to Sales, Operations, Quality, and CNC Programming, leading the activities of assigned projects, maintaining manufacturing plans in the company ERP system. The role will also participate in efforts identifying continuous improvement opportunities and maintaining appropriate documentation. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of manufacturing processes and how the different parts of a production environment fit together.
cond_0220.responsibilities:
Lead teams that develop and maintain cost effective processes and procedures used in the manufacture of parts and assemblies in order to ensure conformance to customer requirements while adhering to the highest quality standards and LEAN principles
Assist Sales by providing information on the technical aspects of projects including ensuring manufacturability, assuring appropriate bids on projects are submitted and providing on-going technical support throughout the duration of assigned projects.
Lead the activities of assigned projects, including supporting the MRB process and providing engineering support to Operations and Quality and troubleshoot as needed to resolve manufacturing process issues and out-of-specification issues.
Develop recommendations for equipment, fixtures and cutting tools necessary to produce parts and/or assemblies. Assist in the development of tooling design and validating alternate materials as required.
Develop and maintain appropriate documentation related to projects responsible for, including engineering changes and manufacturing processes
cond_0220.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor degree in Engineering with 5 years manufacturing experience, or an associate degree with 8 years of experience in similar field
Experience with CAD software
Proficient PC skills in a Windows environment, especially word and excel
Experience in a precision manufacturing environment
Experience in the design and selection of fixturing and tooling for complex parts
Preferred Requirements
Project leadership experience or certifications
LEAN / Six Sigma training and demonstrated application
Experience with CAM software; swiss or milling
Experience working within an ISO 13485 environment

cond_0379.intro: We are looking for a Sr. Manufacturing Engineer to join our team.
cond_0379.responsibilities:
Lead teams that develop and maintain cost effective processes and procedures used in the manufacture of parts and assemblies in order to ensure conformance to customer requirements while adhering to the highest quality standards and LEAN principles
Assist Sales by providing information on the technical aspects of projects including ensuring manufacturability, assuring appropriate bids on projects are submitted and providing on-going technical support throughout the duration of assigned projects.
Lead the activities of assigned projects, including supporting the MRB process and providing engineering support to Operations and Quality and troubleshoot as needed to resolve manufacturing process issues and out-of-specification issues.
Develop recommendations for equipment, fixtures and cutting tools necessary to produce parts and/or assemblies. Assist in the development of tooling design and validating alternate materials as required.
Develop and maintain appropriate documentation related to projects responsible for, including engineering changes and manufacturing processes
cond_0379.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor degree in Engineering with 5 years manufacturing experience, or an associate degree with 8 years of experience in similar field
Experience with CAD software
Proficient PC skills in a Windows environment, especially word and excel
Experience in a precision manufacturing environment
Preferred Requirements
Project leadership experience or certifications
Experience in the design and selection of fixturing and tooling for complex parts
LEAN / Six Sigma training and demonstrated application
Experience with CAM software; swiss or milling
Experience working within an ISO 13485 environment

cond_0392.intro: This position is responsible for providing leadership to technical teams developing and maintaining cost effective processes and procedures for assigned parts used in the manufacture of parts and assemblies. Also, providing technical support to Sales, Operations, Quality, and CNC Programming, leading the activities of assigned projects, maintaining manufacturing plans in the [Company name masked] ERP system. The role will also participate in efforts identifying continuous improvement opportunities and maintaining appropriate documentation. People usually grow into this role over time as they build experience with manufacturing processes and technical problem-solving.
cond_0392.responsibilities:
Lead teams that develop and maintain cost effective processes and procedures used in the manufacture of parts and assemblies in order to ensure conformance to customer requirements while adhering to the highest quality standards and LEAN principles
Assist Sales by providing information on the technical aspects of projects including ensuring manufacturability, assuring appropriate bids on projects are submitted and providing on-going technical support throughout the duration of assigned projects.
Lead the activities of assigned projects, including supporting the MRB process and providing engineering support to Operations and Quality and troubleshoot as needed to resolve manufacturing process issues and out-of-specification issues.
Develop recommendations for equipment, fixtures and cutting tools necessary to produce parts and/or assemblies. Assist in the development of tooling design and validating alternate materials as required.
Develop and maintain appropriate documentation related to projects responsible for, including engineering changes and manufacturing processes
cond_0392.requirements:
Bachelor degree in Engineering with 5 years manufacturing experience, or an associate degree with 8 years of experience in similar field
Experience with CAD software
Project leadership experience or certifications
Proficient PC skills in a Windows environment, especially word and excel
Experience in the design and selection of fixturing and tooling for complex parts
Experience in a precision manufacturing environment
LEAN / Six Sigma training and demonstrated application
Experience with CAM software; swiss or milling
Experience working within an ISO 13485 environment

The role will also participate in efforts identifying continuous improvement opportunities and maintaining appropriate documentation.
cond_0407.responsibilities:
Lead teams that develop and maintain cost effective processes and procedures used in the manufacture of parts and assemblies in order to ensure conformance to customer requirements while adhering to the highest quality standards and LEAN principles
Assist Sales by providing information on the technical aspects of projects including ensuring manufacturability, assuring appropriate bids on projects are submitted and providing on-going technical support throughout the duration of assigned projects.
Lead the activities of assigned projects, including supporting the MRB process and providing engineering support to Operations and Quality and troubleshoot as needed to resolve manufacturing process issues and out-of-specification issues.
Develop recommendations for equipment, fixtures and cutting tools necessary to produce parts and/or assemblies. Assist in the development of tooling design and validating alternate materials as required.
Develop and maintain appropriate documentation related to projects responsible for, including engineering changes and manufacturing processes
cond_0407.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in Engineering required; advanced degree strongly preferred, with a minimum of 8 years of demonstrated expertise in manufacturing, or an associate degree with substantial experience in a similar field
Deep knowledge of CAD software
Proven track record in project leadership; relevant certifications strongly preferred
Strong command of PC skills in a Windows environment, with advanced proficiency in Word and Excel
Extensive expertise in the design and selection of fixturing and tooling for complex parts
Significant experience in a precision manufacturing environment
Advanced knowledge of LEAN / Six Sigma principles with demonstrated application
Proficiency in CAM software; swiss or milling
Solid understanding of ISO 13485 requirements gained through direct experience working within such an environment
cond_0407.encouragement_text: Important: Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply.
cond_0407.values: We value achievement, high standards, and work that is carried out with real discipline. We believe strong organizations are defined by the quality of what they deliver.

cond_0466.responsibilities:
Lead teams that develop and maintain cost-effective processes and procedures used in the manufacture of parts and assemblies, ensuring conformance to customer requirements while adhering to quality standards and LEAN principles

Lead the activities of assigned projects, including supporting the MRB process and providing engineering support to Operations and Quality; troubleshoot manufacturing process issues and out-of-specification issues as they arise

Develop and maintain appropriate documentation related to assigned projects, including engineering changes and manufacturing processes
cond_0466.requirements:
Bachelor degree in Engineering with 5 years manufacturing experience, or an associate degree with 8 years of experience in a similar field
Experience with CAD software
Project leadership experience or certifications
Proficient PC skills in a Windows environment, especially Word and Excel
Experience in the design and selection of fixturing and tooling for complex parts
Experience in a precision manufacturing environment
LEAN / Six Sigma training and demonstrated application
Experience with CAM software; swiss or milling
Experience working within an ISO 13485 environment

Lead teams that develop and maintain cost effective processes and procedures used in the manufacture of parts and assemblies in order to ensure conformance to customer requirements while adhering to the highest quality standards and LEAN principles

Develop and maintain appropriate documentation related to projects responsible for, including engineering changes and manufacturing processes
cond_0553.requirements:
Bachelor degree in Engineering with 5 years manufacturing experience, or an associate degree with 8 years of experience in similar field
Experience with CAD software
Project leadership experience or certifications
Proficient PC skills in a Windows environment, especially word and excel
Experience in the design and selection of fixturing and tooling for complex parts
Experience in a precision manufacturing environment
LEAN / Six Sigma training and demonstrated application
Experience with CAM software; swiss or milling
Experience working within an ISO 13485 environment
